entries.zh: 使相嵌合、入槽对接（榫接、嵌合）
entries.en: to fit one piece into another; to slot together, to joint
entries.notes: 四栏不对音（R「han toy」与 H「拾帶」、M「ham ca」均不合），义仅依 L 栏立解，H 字存疑。

entries.zh: 相合、彼此契合；意见相同、说法一致
entries.en: to fit with one another; to agree, to say the same thing, to be of one accord
entries.notes: R 栏「sing hi」与 H「相合」不对音，然 H/M 与 L（convenir）义合；M 调号污损。

entries.zh: 落锁、上好锁；把锁扣合到位
entries.en: to fit the lock home; to lock a door fast
entries.notes: L「cañadu」（cañado，管槽/锁膛）语义含混，据 H「落鑰」及 M、R 全同取上锁义。

entries.zh: 刀銎——刀身与刀柄接合处的套口（嵌口）
entries.en: the socket or ferrule of a knife, where the blade fits the handle
entries.notes: H 第二字有 [疑]（卿/鄉），按「刀銎（套口）」解；R 首音作 tom，与「刀」对音不合。

entries.zh: 淋屋——以石灰水浇淋房屋（粉墙）
entries.en: to lime-wash a house; to pour lime-water over a building

entries.zh: 淋石灰——化开并涂布石灰
entries.en: to slake and spread lime; to lime-wash

entries.zh: 淋墙——把石灰水淋在墙上粉刷
entries.notes: M 栏末尾赘「Lapaña」（疑地名或人名夹注）不可解，M 第二音节调号污损。

entries.zh: 引路、指引路途；诱人上路
entries.en: to set someone on the road, to guide along the way
entries.notes: R 栏仅存「ien」，有残；M 作「iu, in lu, in bou」三段叠记，H 首字有 [疑]。

entries.zh: 解释、开解；据西语栏兼指为人排解、庇护
entries.en: to explain, to unravel; per L, to set a person right and shelter him
entries.notes: 四栏语义错位——L 为 encaminar/amparar，而 H/M 作「解释」，R「qiang hi」亦不与「解释」对音。

entries.en: to lead the way, to guide
to entice, to lead on, to induce

entries.zh: 装神弄鬼的术士、行巫术惑众者
entries.en: enchanters, sorcerers; charlatans who work spells
entries.notes: H「假述」与 L 义不协（疑为「假鬼」一类讹写），M/R 亦难对音，仅依 L「Encantadores」立解。

entries.zh: 下神者——降神附体的巫者
entries.en: spirit-mediums, those who call a god down into themselves

entries.zh: 天师——画符驱邪的道教法师
entries.en: Taoist Celestial Master; an exorcist priest
to pour water in; to irrigate, to conduct water
to make water gush or splash; to shoot water
entries.notes: H 第二字有 [疑]（水/木），按「水」读，与 M「chuy」、R「zui」相合。

entries.zh: 流觞——引水成曲渠、浮杯而流（曲水流觞）；此指导水成渠
entries.en: floating wine-cups along a winding channel (the qu-shui-liu-shang game); water led in a channel
entries.notes: L 栏「por anca ducer」讹脱难通，H 为典故词，取「引水成渠」义。
